title: Reconcile ORCHESTRATION_ENTRYPOINT_SYSTEM.md's stale task_tier enum with the live one
description: TASK-288's independent review (task288-review-valo, 2026-07-28, RECOMMENDED finding) found that ORCHESTRATION_ENTRYPOINT_SYSTEM.md line 70 documents a task_tier enum (shaping, local, core, helper, approval) that does not match the enum pre_dispatch_policy.py actually enforces and live tasks.task_tier data actually uses (policy, operator, architecture, bounded, mechanical). Pre-existing drift, not caused by TASK-288, and does not affect classify_release()'s correctness (which follows the live enum). Reconcile the doc to match reality: either update ORCHESTRATION_ENTRYPOINT_SYSTEM.md's Dispatch Packet table to the live enum, or if the documented enum describes a different, not-yet-built concept (a dispatch-packet-stage tier distinct from tasks.task_tier), state that distinction explicitly so the two are not read as the same field.
acceptance_criteria: ORCHESTRATION_ENTRYPOINT_SYSTEM.md's task_tier documentation matches either the live tasks.task_tier enum (policy/operator/architecture/bounded/mechanical) used by pre_dispatch_policy.py, or explicitly states why it is a distinct concept with a different name recommended.
grep for task_tier across scripts/pre_dispatch_policy.py, scripts/map_task.py, and a live map.db query confirm the doc now matches reality (or the distinction is explicit).
